name: Nerisopam
summary: Nerisopam (GYKI-52322, EGIS-6775) is a drug which is a 2,3-benzodiazepine derivative, related to tofisopam. It has potent anxiolytic and neuroleptic effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: It has potent anxiolytic and neuroleptic effects in animal studies.

uses.en: It was studied in animals for anti-anxiety and antipsychotic effects and was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾在動物實驗中被研究抗焦慮與抗精神病作用，從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在动物实验中被研究抗焦虑与抗精神病作用，从未上市。

fact.en: It is a 2,3-benzodiazepine, an unusual arrangement of the benzodiazepine ring system. Ordinary benzodiazepines like diazepam are 1,4-benzodiazepines and act at a different site.
fact.zh: 它屬於 2,3-苯二氮平，是苯二氮平環系中較少見的排列方式。一般的苯二氮平如地西泮屬於 1,4-苯二氮平，作用位點也不同。
fact.zhHans: 它属于 2,3-苯二氮平，是苯二氮平环系中较少见的排列方式。一般的苯二氮平如地西泮属于 1,4-苯二氮平，作用位点也不同。
